```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
output_dir <- file.path("results", "jaccard")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot_bundle <- function(plot, stem, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  svglite::svglite(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".svg")), width = width, height = height, bg = "transparent")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height, family = "Arial")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
load(file.path("..", "..", "data", "data_agg", "SNmF_all_agg.Rdata"))
```

## Network Labels
```{r shared-settings}
network_names <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)
```

## Prepare Network Matrices
```{r build-network-list}
if (!is.list(SNmF_all_agg) || length(SNmF_all_agg) != length(network_names)) {
  stop("SNmF_all_agg must contain six network matrices.")
}
network_matrices <- setNames(SNmF_all_agg, network_names)
```

## Jaccard Similarity Function
```{r jaccard-function}
jaccard_vec <- function(mat_a, mat_b) {
  if (!all(dim(mat_a) == dim(mat_b))) {
    stop("mat_a and mat_b must have the same dimensions.")
  }

  n <- nrow(mat_a)
  jaccard <- numeric(n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    a_neighbors <- which(mat_a[i, ] == 1)
    b_neighbors <- which(mat_b[i, ] == 1)
    union_neighbors <- union(a_neighbors, b_neighbors)

    if (length(union_neighbors) == 0) {
      jaccard[i] <- NA
    } else {
      jaccard[i] <- length(intersect(a_neighbors, b_neighbors)) / length(union_neighbors)
    }
  }

  jaccard
}
```

## Pairwise Jaccard Similarities
```{r pairwise-jaccard}
jaccard_results_list <- list()
matrices <- network_matrices
n_networks <- length(matrices)

for (a in seq_len(n_networks - 1)) {
  for (b in (a + 1):n_networks) {
    jaccard <- jaccard_vec(matrices[[a]], matrices[[b]])

    jaccard_results_list[[length(jaccard_results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      netA = names(matrices)[a],
      netB = names(matrices)[b],
      student = rownames(matrices[[a]]),
      jaccard = jaccard
    )
  }
}

jaccard_results <- bind_rows(jaccard_results_list)

```

## Pairwise Summary
```{r pairwise-summary}
jaccard_summary <- jaccard_results %>%
  group_by(netA, netB) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_jacc = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_jacc = sd(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(jaccard)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

## Display Pairwise Summary
```{r pairwise-summary-output}
jaccard_summary
```

## Jaccard Matrix Function
```{r heatmap-matrix-function}
make_symmetric_jaccard_matrix <- function(summary_data, value_col, networks) {
  jaccard_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(networks), ncol = length(networks))
  dimnames(jaccard_matrix) <- list(networks, networks)
  diag(jaccard_matrix) <- 1

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(summary_data))) {
    net_a <- summary_data$netA[i]
    net_b <- summary_data$netB[i]
    value <- summary_data[[value_col]][i]
    jaccard_matrix[net_a, net_b] <- value
    jaccard_matrix[net_b, net_a] <- value
  }

  jaccard_matrix[upper.tri(jaccard_matrix, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
  jaccard_matrix
}
```

## Prepare Heatmap Data
```{r mean-heatmap-data}
jaccard_matrix_mean <- make_symmetric_jaccard_matrix(
  summary_data = jaccard_summary,
  value_col = "mean_jacc",
  networks = network_names
)

jaccard_plot_data <- as.data.frame(as.table(jaccard_matrix_mean))
colnames(jaccard_plot_data) <- c("network1", "network2", "r")
jaccard_plot_data$network1 <- factor(jaccard_plot_data$network1, levels = rev(network_names))
jaccard_plot_data$network2 <- factor(jaccard_plot_data$network2, levels = network_names)
```

## Jaccard Heatmap
```{r mean-heatmap}
jaccard_heatmap <- ggplot(jaccard_plot_data, aes(x = network2, y = network1, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(is.na(r), "", sprintf("%.2f", round(r, 2)))),
    size = 4.3, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FAF0E6", high = "#FF7F00", na.value = "white") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Mean Jaccard Heatmap") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, -50, 0, -50),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

jaccard_heatmap
save_plot_bundle(jaccard_heatmap, "mean_jaccard_heatmap", width = 7, height = 6)
write.csv(jaccard_summary, file.path(output_dir, "jaccard_pairwise_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Network-level Summary
```{r per-network-summary}
per_student <- jaccard_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(netA, netB),
    names_to = "role",
    values_to = "network"
  ) %>%
  group_by(student, network) %>%
  summarise(
    subj_mean_jacc = mean(jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_per_network <- per_student %>%
  group_by(network) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_jacc = mean(subj_mean_jacc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_jacc = sd(subj_mean_jacc, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(subj_mean_jacc)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_per_network
write.csv(summary_per_network, file.path(output_dir, "jaccard_network_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
